difficulty_reason: Descent for fpqc coverings for stacks with quasi-affine diagonal: the faithful part identifies the descent datum with a fibre product via the quasi-affine diagonal, the full part compares isomorphism spaces across the covering, and the essentially-surjective part constructs the descent object locally and glues; both segments complete in-span.
